meta.name: agents-sdk
meta.description: Build AI agents on Cloudflare Workers using the Agents SDK. Load when creating stateful agents, durable workflows, real-time WebSocket apps, scheduled tasks, MCP servers, or chat applications. Covers Agent class, state management, callable RPC, Workflows integration, and React hooks.

copy.tagline: 在 Cloudflare Workers 上构建有状态的 AI 智能体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在 Cloudflare Workers 上开发带状态和持久化能力的 AI 应用
copy.tagline_en: Build stateful AI agents on Cloudflare Workers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop stateful and persistent AI apps on Cloudflare Workers

howto.what: Claude 会先查询 Cloudflare Agents SDK 的最新文档,再按文档生成或修改代码。它可帮你实现 Agent 类、状态存储、远程方法调用、定时任务、Workflows 流程、MCP 连接与 React hooks 客户端。
howto.when: 当你提出创建有状态 Agent、持久化工作流或实时通信应用等需求时触发,例如定时任务或聊天机器人。

say.text: 帮我在 Cloudflare Workers 上写一个有状态计数器 Agent。
我要给 Agent 加一个每天执行的定时任务,怎么配置?
用 useAgent 写一个 React 组件连接我的 ChatRoom 实例。
say.note: Claude 会生成客户端代码并连接对应实例。

howto.what_en: Claude will first fetch the latest Agents SDK docs, then generate or modify code accordingly. It can help with Agent class, state persistence, callable RPC, scheduling, Workflows, MCP integration, and React hooks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build stateful agents, durable workflows, or real-time apps, such as scheduled tasks or chatbots.

say_en.text: Write a stateful counter Agent on Cloudflare Workers.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the Agent class and routing.

say_en.text: Add a daily scheduled task to my Agent.
say_en.note: Claude will use scheduleEvery or cron syntax.

say_en.text: Write a React component using useAgent to connect to my ChatRoom instance.
say_en.note: Claude will generate client code connecting to that instance.
